title: Central Authority must cause investigation
description: The Central Authority must cause an investigation to be made if it is satisfied that there exists a prima facie case of violation of consumer rights or unfair trade practice

content.what: must cause investigation to be made
conditions: if it is satisfied that there exists a prima facie case of violation of consumer rights or unfair trade practice
limitations: prejudicial to the public interest or to the interests of consumers
